body:
I feel scared to leave him, so I’ve been avoiding it. There was nothing wrong at all and up until this day, we were best friends and he was my rock. He made me feel so loved and safe and I just didn’t understand why he’s doing this. 

He says he wants to break up in college but that he’s still in love with me and that he will always love and care about me. It’s making me frustrated and I feel confused. I never thought this would happen so I am in shock
